_comment: Reference data for tools/report_sections.py — the reader that merges the analyst `report` blocks evidence_import stored under cases/<case>/evidence/imported/ and builds the 'Sources checked' appendix from the case's tool-call ledger (cases/<case>/tool_calls.jsonl) and the case-scoped rows of the licensed-API ledger (MEMORY/api_usage.jsonl). The row SCHEMA (required keys, enums, id patterns) lives in evidence_import.json `report_sections`; this file only holds merge keys, ledger field names and the public source-class wording. RULE 1: vocabulary only, never case data.

merge_keys._comment: Section -> the row keys that identify one row across imports. A later import (by file mtime) replaces an earlier row with the same key. Sections carrying an `id` (KQ-nn, OQ-nn, SC-nn, Tnnn, MAP-nn) merge on it; roles / roadmap / counting_rules have no id and merge on a content key (compared case-insensitively, whitespace-collapsed).

selector_args._comment: Tool-call ledger `args` keys read, in order, as the SELECTOR a call was made against. The first non-empty one wins; a call with none of them is recorded against the whole case ('(case)').

hit_fields._comment: Record fields read (in order) as the number of results a call returned. An int is used as-is, a list/dict by its length. A record carrying none of them has hits 'unknown' — never guessed. The tool-call ledger currently records arguments only, so its rows are 'unknown' unless a future ledger adds one of these fields.

error_fields._comment: Record fields whose truthy value marks the call as an error. A licensed-API row with ok=false is an error as well.

source_classes._comment: Tool / provider name (lower-case) -> the PUBLIC source class shown in the report's 'Sources checked' appendix (IntelReport Rule 12: no internal tool or vendor names in the report). Unlisted names fall back to the name with underscores as spaces, then the house vendor scrub.

lint._comment: report_sections.lint() — QA warnings over the subject_profile / client_seeds rows (warn, never block; rendered as the house report's 'QA warnings' appendix and returned as evidence_import `report_lint`). profile_fields = the subject_profile field enum. Identifier keys: e-mail lower-cased; a phone = digits only (>= min_phone_digits) for phone_fields; a profile URL on a platform_hosts host -> <platform>:<numeric id> (from id_query_params, an all-digit path segment of >= min_id_digits, or basis_id_pattern on the row's basis) plus handle:<vanity> (first path segment after skip_path_segments); an alias/account value -> handle:<lower, @ stripped>, or <platform>:<id> when it is all digits and the row's source is a platform URL. compatible_fields = field groups one identifier may legitimately sit under on ONE entity (any other pair is 'incompatible'); wildcard_fields never conflict. basis_required_fields need basis + source (evidence_import also rejects them without). single_valued_fields: a client seed that differs from every CONFIRMED row of the field is a contradiction (dates compared after date_formats parsing). seed_type_fields maps a client seed `type` onto a profile field. Near-duplicate handles: edit distance 1 or equal once . _ - are removed, both at least near_duplicate_min_length long; finding_handle_types = finding indicator types also checked.
